description: This file defines a custom exception class `GitlabIdentityProviderException` used within the OAuth2 GitLab provider implementation. It extends the `IdentityProviderException` class and provides static methods to generate exceptions based on HTTP responses and parsed data. The class facilitates handling specific OAuth2 error scenarios related to GitLab within an OAuth2 client library.

classes.name: GitlabIdentityProviderException
classes.description: A custom exception class specialized for handling OAuth2 errors from GitLab. It provides static methods to create exceptions based on HTTP responses and parsed response data, helping client code handle various error conditions gracefully.

methods.name: clientException
methods.description: Creates a client exception using the response and parsed data, defaulting to the response's reason phrase if no message is provided.

methods.name: oauthException
methods.description: Creates an OAuth-related exception from the response and parsed data, defaulting to the response's reason phrase if no error message is provided.

methods.name: fromResponse
methods.description: Generates an instance of `GitlabIdentityProviderException` from the HTTP response and an optional message, capturing the response status code and body.
